title: TailTrail Host Question Flow Redaction and Retention Policy
description: Redaction and retention for host observations, answers, and artifacts (Phase 0). Per TAILTRAIL-HOST-QUESTION-FLOW-IMPLEMENTATION-PLAN.md's Review Resolution #3, this starts from the shipped shaped-secret catalog already enforced in scripts/quality-loop.py (SECRET_SHAPES: AWS access key, GitHub token, Slack token, PEM private key, bearer token) rather than inventing a parallel pattern list. tests/test_host_question_flow_redaction_policy.py asserts this schema's shape_name enum stays in sync with that module.

stage.description: Redaction happens at ingestion, not only at report-rendering time (design doc Implementation Risks: 'Redact at ingestion, not only during report rendering').
